1: // Simple Pixel Runner game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800);
9:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 200);
10: 
11:   const player = { x: 50, y: H - 30, w: 20, h: 20, vy: 0, onGround: true };
12:   const gravity = 0.8;
13:   const jumpForce = 15;
14:   const obstacles = [];
15:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
16:   let score = 0;
17:   let gameOver = false;
18: 
19:   function spawnObstacle() {
20:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 20;
21:     obstacles.push({ x: W, y: H - size, w: size, h: size });
22:   }
23: 
24:   function update() {
25:     if (gameOver) return;
26:     // player physics
27:     player.vy += gravity;
28:     player.y += player.vy;
29:     if (player.y + player.h >= H) {
30:       player.y = H - player.h;
31:       player.vy = 0;
32:       player.onGround = true;
33:     } else {
34:       player.onGround = false;
35:     }
36:     // obstacles move left
37:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
38:       const o = obstacles[i];
39:       o.x -= 5;
40:       // collision
41:       if (
42:         player.x < o.x + o.w &&
43:         player.x + player.w > o.x &&
44:         player.y < o.y + o.h &&
45:         player.y + player.h > o.y
46:       ) {
47:         gameOver = true;
48:       }
49:       // remove off‑screen
50:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
51:     }
52:     // spawn obstacles periodically
53:     obstacleTimer--;
54:     if (obstacleTimer <= 0) {
55:       spawnObstacle();
56:       obstacleTimer = 90 + Math.random() * 60; // frames
57:     }
58:     // score based on time survived
59:     score++;
60:   }
61: 
62:   function draw() {
63:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
64:     // player
65:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
66:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
67:     // obstacles
68:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
69:     obstacles.forEach(o => ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h));
70:     // score & game over
71:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
72:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
73:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score / 60), 10, 20);
74:     if (gameOver) {
75:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
76:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
77:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
78:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
79:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 60, H / 2);
80:     }
81:   }
82: 
83:   function loop() {
84:     update();
85:     draw();
86:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
87:   }
88: 
89:   // input – click or tap to jump
90:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
91:     if (player.onGround && !gameOver) player.vy = -jumpForce;
92:   });
93:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
94:     e.preventDefault();
95:     if (player.onGround && !gameOver) player.vy = -jumpForce;
96:   }, { passive: false });
97: 
98:   // start game
99:   loop();
100: })();

(End of file - total 100 lines)
</content>
